prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.go in package solution.
Required API: func EscapedFieldParser(input string) (string, bool)
Behavior: Parse comma-separated fields where backslash may escape only comma or backslash. Empty fields are retained. Reject a dangling backslash or any other escape. Return decoded fields joined by |.
Visible example: a\,b,c\\d, returns a,b|c\d|; a\q is invalid.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
